startup.text: Recommended training and start-up of the unit is available from PAC at a flate rate of $5,480 for two days. This rate includes 8 hours per day of start-up and training plus all travel and living expenses within the USA. This flat rate only applies to new machine orders and must be purchased with the machine. Technician must be scheduled 3 weeks prior to install date.
